_note: Structural and phrasal AI tics. `why` states the evidence; `fix` is the remediation. Severity: blocker/major/minor. Sources are recorded in docs/research-basis.md.

artifacts.pattern: \bas an ai(?: language)?(?: model)?\b|\bi'?m an ai\b|\bi (?:cannot|can'?t) browse the (?:internet|web)\b|\bmy (?:knowledge|training) (?:cutoff|data) (?:is|extends)\b
artifacts.why: the assistant's chat frame leaked into the document

artifacts.pattern: \b(?:certainly|absolutely|of course)[!,]\s+(?:here'?s|here is|i'?d be happy)\b|\bi hope this helps\b|\bgreat question\b|\blet me know if you(?:'d| would) like\b|\bfeel free to (?:ask|reach out)\b

artifacts.why: generated scaffolding was never filled in
appeal to unnamed authority; the classic shape of a fabricated citation
artifacts.fix: cite the source or delete the claim

phrases.pattern: \bit(?:'s| is|\u2019s) (?:also )?(?:important|worth|essential|crucial|vital|necessary) to (?:note|remember|mention|understand|recognize|consider|point out|highlight)(?: that)?\b|\bit (?:should|must) be noted that\b|\bit is worth noting that\b
phrases.why: pure preamble; the sentence works without it
phrases.fix: delete it and state the point

phrases.pattern: \bin (?:today|toady)(?:'s|\u2019s) (?:(?:fast-paced|digital|modern|ever-changing|ever-evolving|competitive|dynamic|rapidly changing|complex) ){0,3}(?:world|age|era|landscape|environment|market|climate)\b|\bin the (?:ever-)?(?:evolving|changing|modern) (?:world|landscape|field|realm) of\b|\bin an era (?:of|where)\b
phrases.why: generic scene-setting that carries no information
phrases.fix: delete the clause; start at the point

phrases.pattern: \bplays? an? (?:crucial|vital|pivotal|key|significant|critical|important|central) role\b|\bis (?:crucial|vital|pivotal|essential|critical) (?:for|to|in)\b|\bcannot be overstated\b
phrases.why: asserts importance instead of stating what the thing does
phrases.fix: say what it does, or give the consequence of not doing it

phrases.pattern: \b(?:it|this|that)(?:'s| is|\u2019s| was)? not (?:just|only|merely|simply) (?:about )?[^.;\u2014\u2013]{2,60}[,;\u2014\u2013-]+\s*(?:it(?:'s| is|\u2019s| was)?|but)\b|\bnot (?:just|only|merely|simply) an? [^.;\u2014\u2013]{2,50}[,;\u2014\u2013-]+\s*but\b|\bmore than just an?\b|\b(?:isn'?t|is not|wasn'?t|was not) (?:just|merely|only) [^.;]{2,50}[.;]\s*(?:It|This|That) (?:is|was|\u2019s|'s)\b
phrases.why: the antithesis template: sets up a strawman to sound profound
phrases.fix: state the one thing that is true

phrases.pattern: \b(?:is|are|was|were|be) an? [a-z][a-z -]{2,30}, not an? [a-z][a-z -]{2,30}\b|\b[a-z]{3,} (?:is|are) the (?:job|point|goal), not\b
phrases.why: the 'X, not Y' figure; fine once, a rhythm in bulk
phrases.fix: budgeted -- keep the strongest one

phrases.pattern: \bThe (?:result|answer|reason|difference|problem|question|catch|upshot|takeaway|bottom line)\?\s
phrases.why: self-posed question-and-answer; a generated rhetorical beat
phrases.fix: state the answer as a sentence

phrases.pattern: \bhere(?:'s|\u2019s| is) (?:the thing|where it gets|the kicker|the catch|the best part)\b|\bbut (?:here'?s|there'?s) the (?:thing|catch|rub)\b|\bwait,? (?:there'?s|it gets)\b
phrases.why: manufactured suspense in a document the reader is scanning
phrases.fix: delete; lead with the fact

phrases.pattern: \bNot [^.\n]{1,40}\. Not [^.\n]{1,40}\. (?:Just|Only|Simply)
phrases.why: the Not-X-Not-Y-just-Z cadence
phrases.fix: one sentence stating what it is

phrases.pattern: \b(?:serves|stands|functions|acts|operates|exists) as an?(?! long\b| if\b| though\b)\b|\bis a testament to\b|\bstands as an?\b
phrases.why: a weak copula dressed up; usually 'is' or a real verb
phrases.fix: use the concrete verb

phrases.pattern: ,\s*(?:thereby\s+)?(?:highlighting|underscoring|emphasizing|showcasing|illustrating|reinforcing|solidifying|cementing|signaling|underlining|exemplifying|paving the way|setting the stage|ushering in|marking a)\b
phrases.why: trailing participial clause that editorializes rather than informs; present participial clauses are elevated in LLM text (see research-basis.md). Verbs that commonly do real work in a trailing clause -- allowing, enabling, ensuring, causing -- are deliberately excluded: calibration showed them in legitimate pre-LLM prose.
phrases.fix: make it its own sentence, or delete the editorial

phrases.pattern: \bin this (?:article|post|guide|blog|section|chapter|document|tutorial),? (?:we(?:'ll| will|\u2019ll)|you(?:'ll| will|\u2019ll)|i(?:'ll| will|\u2019ll)|let(?:'s|\u2019s))\b|\bwe(?:'ll| will|\u2019ll) (?:explore|cover|dive into|take a look at|walk through) (?:the|how|what|why)\b
phrases.why: table-of-contents narration; headings already do this
phrases.fix: delete; let the headings carry the structure

phrases.pattern: \bin conclusion\b|\bto (?:sum up|summarize)\b|\bin summary,\b|\ball in all\b|\bat the end of the day\b|\bonly time will tell\b|\bthe (?:possibilities|opportunities) are (?:endless|limitless)\b
phrases.why: school-essay sign-off; documentation ends at the last fact
phrases.fix: end with the result or the next action

phrases.pattern: \bwhether you(?:'re| are|\u2019re) an? [^.,]{2,40},? (?:an?|or) [^.,]{2,40},? or\b|\bfrom (?:beginners?|novices?) to (?:experts?|professionals?|veterans?)\b
phrases.why: audience-flattering enumeration; classic generated opener
phrases.fix: address the one reader this page is for

phrases.pattern: \blet(?:'s|\u2019s) (?:dive|delve|jump|get) (?:in|into|deeper|started)\b|\bwithout further ado\b|\blook no further\b|\bbuckle up\b|\bthat(?:'s|\u2019s) where [a-z]{2,20} comes in\b|\bbut wait,? there(?:'s|\u2019s) more\b
phrases.why: marketing-blog register
phrases.fix: delete

phrases.pattern: \ba (?:wide|broad|vast|diverse|rich) (?:range|variety|array|selection) of\b|\ba (?:myriad|plethora|multitude) of\b|\bcountless\b|\ba host of\b
phrases.why: gestures at quantity instead of giving it
phrases.fix: give the number, or three examples

phrases.pattern: \bunlock(?:s|ing)? the (?:power|potential|full potential|secrets|value) of\b|\btake [^.]{1,30} to the next level\b|\bharness(?:es|ing)? the (?:power|full power) of\b|\bsupercharge\b|\bgame[- ]chang(?:er|ing)\b
phrases.why: advertising copy
phrases.fix: state the concrete capability and its limit

phrases.pattern: \bwhen it comes to\b|\bin the realm of\b|\bin the world of\b|\bneedless to say\b|\bit goes without saying\b|\bthat being said\b
phrases.why: connective filler
phrases.fix: delete, or use the concrete relationship

phrases.pattern: \bfew would (?:disagree|argue|deny)\b|\bit(?:'s| is|\u2019s) (?:widely|generally|universally) (?:known|accepted|agreed|understood)\b|\bmost (?:experts|developers|engineers) (?:agree|would agree)\b
phrases.why: unsupported appeal to consensus
phrases.fix: cite it or drop it

phrases.pattern: \bbest practices?\b(?!\s*(?:document|guide|doc)\b)|\bindustry[- ]standard\b|\bstate[- ]of[- ]the[- ]art\b|\bcutting[- ]edge\b
phrases.why: appeals to authority without naming the practice
phrases.fix: name the practice and who recommends it

phrases.pattern: \beach with (?:its|their) own\b|\bcomes? with (?:its|their) own set of\b|\ba double[- ]edged sword\b
phrases.why: elaboration that promises specifics and never delivers
phrases.fix: name the differences, or cut
